newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Shinawatra Computer rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Shinawatra Computer rated buy.

text.p: Asia Equity Ltd recommended on Wednesday that investors buy Thai telecommunication conglomerate, Shinawatra Computer and Communications Plc, saying its shares were underpriced.
"SHIN has underperformed as investors have focused on likely downgrades to SHIN's trading business in the current economic environment," the firm said in a research report.
Asia Equity said it agreed that SHIN's earnings were basically supported by Advanced Info Services Plc and Shinawatra Satellite Plc.
"However, this has been overdone. Even if SHIN's trading operations were to make no profit, the company would still be trading on undemanding multiples," it said.
All the three companies are under the Shinawatra Group.
"We estimate an NAV (net asset value) for SHIN of 338 baht per share, 15 percent above the current share price," Asia Equity said.
Shinawatra Computer and Communications was trading at 268 baht, down eight baht, at the lunch break on Wednesday.
